briefings.title: BREAKING NEWS: Jeanine Pirro Holds Briefing After Judge Blocks Subpoenas In Jerome Powell Case
briefings.tldr: U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro announced the DOJ will appeal an "activist" ruling by Judge James Boasberg that blocked grand jury subpoenas investigating Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell for $1 billion in renovation cost overruns.

briefings.title: LIVE: Jeanine Pirro Holds Press Briefing On Investigation Of Fed Chair Jerome Powell
briefings.tldr: U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro condemned a federal judge's decision to quash grand jury subpoenas in a criminal investigation of Fed Chair Jerome Powell regarding $1 billion in renovation cost overruns, labeling the ruling "judicial activism" that grants Powell unlawful immunity.
